description: Election Commission - Parliamentary Election - 2024 The List of Political Parties and Secretaries.
reasoning: This gazette notice is issued under the Parliamentary Elections Act and specifically deals with the recognition status of political parties for an upcoming parliamentary election. It contains the official list of recognized parties eligible to submit nominations and identifies parties that cannot participate due to internal disputes. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns electoral processes, candidate nominations, and election commission decisions related to an upcoming parliamentary election.
